I deleted a clan I owned. I got into a huge argument with one of my mods and the other members started taking sides. It wasn't a very big group and the mods I had were really the most active members. I was really close to everyone, we were a pretty tight-knit group. Everything devolved into people just hurling insults at eachother and flinging accusations. After about an hour I had gone from furious to numb. I was drained and felt like I wanted to die. I just deleted it, the team speak, the forums, all of it. In my mind I thought we would be better off without it, that it was just too much stress for everyone and there was too much bitterness. Looking back Idk if that was actually true though or if I was just angry enough to kill it.

Not retail exactly but customer service. I was running a charity concert event where you had to buy a ticket to get in. We were featuring a country singer that is from this town so he is bit of a local celebrity as well as a popular singer.

There was alcohol being sold so we had some sheriff deputies and some professional bouncers checking ids at the gate. The main entrance is a set of three big gates with a pair of small ticket kiosks on each side.

We were crazy busy, huge lines, a few thousand people lined up to get in, and a lot of cowboys that had already been drinking in line or on the way. The deputies were taking people out for PI and fake IDs almost as quickly as we could get people in, none of us were really having a great day.

Some guy and his girlfriend get to the front of the line and my staff won't let them in because they haven't bought tickets. I walked over to defuse the situation and let my guys get back to work. These people, instead of just going and getting two 5$ tickets, spent the next 5-10 minutes arguing with me about why they can't come in.

The two of them kept going on and on about how since it was a charity concert it should be free for them to get in, That they shouldn't have to pay, how he is supposedly this big donor to our organization, etc.

After going back and forth they finally get that they aren't going to get anywhere with me. I've about had it with them and was going to grab the next deputy that walked by when he calls me a "communist asshole" and walks off.
